The '''ripper''' was an [[Old Republic era|Old Republic]] weapon designed to bypass [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]] by firing physical projectiles. The ripper fired many pieces of shrapnel at a target, in a similar manner to the [[Flechette/Legends|flechette]] weapons later used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The shrapnel fired by the ripper penetrated deep into the target's body, causing additional damage.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

A variant of this weapon was the [[Mandalorian ripper]], which was also a pistol designed to bypass personal energy shields.
